general_information.Syllabus Name: Risk Management in Information Systems_Quản trị rủi ro trong hệ thống thông tin
general_information.Description: The course provides a comprehensive view of managing risk in information systems. It covers the fundamentals of risk and risk management and also includes in-depth details on more comprehensive risk management topics. Areas of instruction include how to assess and manage risk based on defining an acceptable level of risk for information systems. Elements of a business impact analysis (BIA), business continuity plan (BCP), disaster recovery plan (DRP) and computer incident response team (CIRT) plan are also discussed.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Students are responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit in time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: Internet, Student VM workstation with Microsoft Office 2007 or higher, Zenmap, Nessus, AI Tools: ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot,…

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the fundamental concepts of risk management and its importance.
Understand methods of mitigating risk by managing threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits.
Identify compliance laws, standards, best practices, and policies of risk management.
Describe the components of an effective risk management plan.
Describe approaches for identifying and analyzing relevant threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits.
Describe the process of performing risk assessments.
Identify assets and activities to be protected within an organization.
Identify and analyze threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits.
Identify and analyze risk mitigation security controls.
Describe the process of planning risk mitigation throughout an organization.
Describe the process of implementing a risk mitigation plan.
Review a business continuity plan (BCP) based on the findings of a given risk assessment for an organization.
Review a disaster recovery plan (DRP) based on the findings of a given risk assessment for an organization.
Review a computer incident response team (CIRT) plan for an organization.

assessments.Grading Guide: Each team have 45 minutes for presentation. Evaluate the final presentation, based on what the teams introduce, share, and demonstrate their final report, mainly focus on: - Phase 1: Risk Identification & Assessment 20% - Phase 2: Mitigation Planning 25% - Phase 3: Response & Recovery 30% - Presentation: 10% - Team working: 15%
assessments.Note: 1. Project Implementation: - Mode: Students work in assigned teams (3-5 members) to develop a comprehensive Risk Management Framework for a simulated enterprise of their choice (e.g., FinTech startup, healthcare provider, e-commerce platform). - Project Scope: The project is scaffolded throughout the semester, with deliverables aligning with lecture topics: + Phase 1: Risk Identification & Assessment: Define the enterprise, its critical assets, and conduct a qualitative risk assessment. + Phase 2: Mitigation Planning: Develop policies and select security controls to treat identified risks, including a cost-benefit analysis. + Phase 3: Response & Recovery: Create core components of a resilient framework: a Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Business Continuity Plan (BCP), Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP), and a Computer Incident Response Team (CIRT) plan. - AI Integration: Students are required to use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) for specific, defined tasks such as brainstorming threat scenarios, critiquing their plan's alignment with standards like NIST or ISO 27001, and simulating attacker/auditor perspectives. All AI-generated content must be critically evaluated and integrated with proper justification. 2. Final Project Portfolio A consolidated written report (20-30 pages) that serves as the complete Risk Management Framework, including: - Executive Summary & Problem Context: A clear description of the simulated enterprise and the business environment it operates in. - Comprehensive Risk Analysis: Detailed identification of assets, threats, vulnerabilities, and the assessed impact/likelihood of risks. - Proposed Mitigation Strategy: A detailed plan outlining selected technical and managerial controls, prioritized based on a cost-benefit analysis and mapped to relevant compliance standards (e.g., COBIT P09, NIST CSF, ISO 27001). - Response & Recovery Annexes: Summaries of the BIA, BCP, DRP, and CIRT strategies tailored to the enterprise. - AI Usage Reflection (2-3 pages): A dedicated appendix explaining "how" and "why" AI was used at various stages (e.g., "We used AI to generate potential attack vectors for our web application, which we then validated against the OWASP Top 10"). It must critically discuss the reliability of the outputs and the team's process for verification.
